name: scr1be/phpstan-runner
description: PHPStan, installed apart from the Magento installation on purpose. Magento 2.4.8 pins phpstan/phpstan ^1.9 in its own composer.json and rector holds it at ^1.12.5, so requiring 2.x there would drag the stand's dev dependencies along with it. Nothing here is a Magento module; it exists so `phpstan.neon` has a binary to run.
